passages.text: What is that which gleams through me, and strikes my heart without hurting it; and I shudder and kindle? I shudder, inasmuch as I am unlike it; I kindle, inasmuch as I am like it.
passages.note: Awe before the sacred; feeling both unworthy and drawn

passages.text: For in hope we are saved, wherefore we through patience wait for Thy promises.

It is one thing to answer enquiries, another to make sport of enquirers. So I answer not; for rather had I answer, "I know not," what I know not, than so as to raise a laugh at him who asketh deep things and gain praise for one who answereth false things.
passages.note: Honestly admitting ignorance rather than mocking questions
